response.sql:
SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE a.date >= '1994-06-17'
  AND a.date <= '1996-09-02'
GROUP BY d.A3;

assumptions.assumption: Account dates use a text representation whose lexical order matches the requested YYYY-MM-DD range, so the bounds are inclusive text comparisons.
